children: GridAI Technologies amended and restated its secured convertible promissory note with Pronghorn Resources on September 4, 2026, adding a second loan of $964,000 and bringing total financing under the note to approximately $2.964 million. In tandem, the parties executed a First Amendment to the Security Agreement to update references and keep collateral terms aligned with the revised note. The moves are intended to support Pronghorn’s funding needs while maintaining GridAI’s conversion and security protections.
